Follow `AGENTS.md` as the repository-wide engineering contract.

Blueballs uses repository-local verification. Do not create or depend on GitHub Actions or `.github/workflows/**` unless the user prompt literally contains `ALLOW GITHUB ACTIONS FOR THIS TASK`.

Treat public code comments, README/docs, changelogs and commit messages as product surfaces: be confident, precise and capability-led. Fix engineering gaps in code/tests rather than advertising them as public product weaknesses. Never invent partnerships, certifications, audits or live integrations.
